ratios.facility: 2026 Senior Credit Facility and Note Purchase Facility
ratios.quote: The leverage ratio was required to be less than or equal to 4.00 to 1.00 as of the last day of each fiscal quarter.
The fixed charge coverage ratio was required to be greater than or equal to 2.00 to 1.00 as of the last day of each fiscal quarter.

parsed.notes: The filing gives only the covenant requirements and says the Company was in compliance with all debt covenants as of September 26, 2026; it does not disclose actual ratio values. The leverage ratio (total funded debt to consolidated EBITDAR) applies to both the 2026 Senior Credit Facility and the Note Purchase Facility. The fixed charge coverage ratio (EBITDAR to interest paid plus rent) applies only to the Note Purchase Facility. That is a private note purchase agreement rather than a bank facility, but it is a quarterly maintenance covenant, so it is included. Both ratios are measured on a trailing twelve-month basis.
